Claimed(address,address,uint256,uint256).details: Emit this event to track claim information when participants claim

params.allocation: The amount of the participant's token allocation
params.participant: The address of the user who contributed
params.recipient: The address of the user who received the token allocation
params.userShare: The amount of the participant's contribution

Deployed(address,address,uint256,uint256.details: Use primitives for important information, bytes type compression for other information.

params.auctionToken: The address of the token being auctioned
params.closingAt: The timestamp when the auction ends
params.raisedTokens: Concatenated addresses of the raised tokens
params.startingAt: The timestamp when the auction starts

Raised(address,address,uint256).details: Emit this event when the auction receives funds from participants to track raised information

params.amount: The amount of the raised token
params.participant: The address of the user who contributed
params.token: The address of the raised token

initialize().details: Expected to be called by the factory's deployAuction function
